policy.visibility: Every current future fixture with a readable source/model path is visible; terminal/settled fixtures are removed from this board.
policy.confidence: Evidence depth changes confidence/status; it does not erase the fixture.

policy.ranking: Deep model > deep research projection > research model > testing projection.
policy.market_rule: Market prices are reference/enrichment data, never displayed as independent model probabilities.
